_about: Ratchets for the deterministic gates in docs/RELEASE_STANDARD.md, Part B. Lower a value whenever the measured figure drops. Raise one only with a stated reason in the pull request. Release-time CPU and memory budgets live in docs/perf-budgets.json, not here.

window_process_modules.note: Modules loaded by importing the window process's modules (tests/test_import_hygiene.py), Windows. 303 on Python 3.12.10 (CI test install, 16 Oct 2026); 313 on Python 3.14.8 (full runtime lock, 17 Oct 2026, #111 B4: the standard library imports a few more modules), within the unchanged budget; the test prints the current count. About 5% headroom at 313 (10% at 303) for patch-level differences between Python and package builds.

package_zip_mb.note: Size of the package zip in MB (tools/build_package.py checks every build). Release build of b12e462 (#111 B2b: pruned, precompiled), Python 3.14.8, 17 Oct 2026: 374.8 MB. About 5% headroom; the precompiled .pyc are about 79 MB of it. A dependency change that adds size must say why in its pull request.

package_files.note: Files in the package zip (tools/build_package.py checks every build). Release build of b12e462 (#111 B2b), Python 3.14.8, 17 Oct 2026: 22,815 (27,794 before pruning and precompiling). About 5% headroom.

app_css_raw_colours.note: Colour literals in workspace/ui/app.css outside tokens.css: hex (also %23 hex inside a data URI), rgb(), hsl() and named colours (tests/test_consistency.py). 24 on 16 Oct 2026; R12b (#133, 17 Oct 2026) moved each to a token with the same value, and R12c (#186, 18 Oct 2026) drew the success toast's tick as a mask filled from --success: 0. A new colour goes in tokens.css.

ui_idle.note: What the idle Meetings page does per minute of page time (tools/ui_idle_check.py, headless Edge with the design fixtures). Lowered by R6 (#127) on 16 Oct 2026: visible 120 bridge calls and 30 list rebuilds a minute became 24 and 0, and hidden became nothing at all (the standard, section 3: while hidden, nothing polls faster than once every 30 s). Polling is now a timeout chain (one timeout per poll, every 10 s when idle) instead of a 2 s interval, so timeouts_per_minute was raised from 0 to 6 on purpose. Lowered again by R7b (#128) on 16 Oct 2026: visible 24 bridge calls a minute became 14, because the page asks for the meeting list and reminders only when status() reports a change, and every 6th poll anyway (status and recording_status every poll, the two lists once a minute). fastest_interval_ms is a floor: an interval faster than it fails, and no interval passes. A page that throws, or makes no bridge calls when visible, fails regardless.

ui_transcribing.note: What the page fetches and draws while a long meeting (3,000 passages) is open and being transcribed: 12 steps of 4 s page time, ten adding passages, with an earlier chunk done again, an edit started while the page was loading new passages, speakers identified and a search on the way (tools/ui_idle_check.py, transcribing mode of tools/design_check/fixtures.js). Counts, not times, so the same on any machine. Added by #127 on 19 Oct 2026: redrawing the whole list on every progress change takes 48 transcript calls, 36,600 rows fetched, 33,555 drawn and 11 full redraws; appending new passages takes 22 calls, 9,250 rows fetched, 9,225 drawn and 3 full redraws, the three the scenario requires (the earlier chunk, speakers, the search). An append given up because the edit started while it loaded fetches 11 rows in one call and draws nothing; once the edit ends, with nothing else changed, the next refresh appends those 10 rows. Figures remeasured on 19 Oct 2026 after step 6 stopped adding passages (round 2 review), for both pages on the same scenario.

ui_recording.note: What the Meetings page does per minute of page time with a recording going (tools/ui_idle_check.py, the recording scenario of tools/design_check/fixtures.js on a simulated 120 Hz display, visible and hidden; #340). Counts, not times. Added on 23 Oct 2026 at main 98038e8 (the meter at about 60 a second, the owner's decision of 23 Oct 2026, #216), from 10 headless runs on the development laptop (5 on 23 Oct and 5 on 24 Oct 2026) and the CI runner's run, every one giving the same figures, so the median is each figure. Visible: 629 recording_status calls a minute (the clock and level: a 100 ms timer, about 600, and one with each 2 s poll, 30), 30 status calls (the 2 s poll), and the meeting list and reminders 5 times each (every 6th poll); 30 timeouts (the poll chain); one 100 ms interval (the clock and level), so fastest_interval_ms is a floor of 100 here; one animation frame pending (the meter's loop); the meter drew 60 times a second, every 2nd display frame (METER_HZ in workspace/ui/app.js); the meeting list was rebuilt 0 times, ratcheted at 0 visible and hidden by #348 on 24 Oct 2026 (measured 0 in every run above), so a recording poll that rebuilt it fails. Hidden: nothing polls and the meter draws nothing; the meter's one frame stays pending, as a minimised window runs no frames. The check also fails a page that throws, stops asking for recording_status, draws the meter more than 10% from METER_HZ while visible, or does not ask and draw again within 1 s of being shown.
